intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.

sections.heading: Asian School of Business Trivandrum vs KITTS for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Asian School of Business Trivandrum if you want a 2024 flagship package record of ₹4.38 LPA, and an admission route through CAT, CMAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Thiruvananthapuram.
Choose KITTS only after you have checked the official MBA / PGDM brochure, because our records for fees or placements on this page are thin.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for Asian School of Business Trivandrum that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for KITTS that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Asian School of Business Trivandrum's latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹4.38 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for KITTS here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Asian School of Business Trivandrum is listed on our records with CAT, CMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for KITTS on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Kerala. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Asian School of Business Trivandrum is listed as a private institute and KITTS as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, Asian School of Business Trivandrum is the clearer record here, because KITTS has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
KITTS is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded MBA / PGDM offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Asian School of Business Trivandrum or KITTS?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Asian School of Business Trivandrum and KITTS differ in more than one way: one is listed as private and the other as public. Check official fees, the admission test and the latest placement report before you choose.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Asian School of Business Trivandrum vs KITTS?
faqs.answer: we do not hold a quotable fee for Asian School of Business Trivandrum on this page; we do not hold a quotable fee for KITTS on this page. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Asian School of Business Trivandrum and KITTS?
faqs.answer: Asian School of Business Trivandrum's latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹4.38 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Asian School of Business Trivandrum and KITTS accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT, CMAT for Asian School of Business Trivandrum, and no listed exam on this page for KITTS. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Asian School of Business Trivandrum and KITTS in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
